earnings.title: United Rentals, Inc.
highlights: Total revenue of $4.893 billion, including rental revenue 1 of $4.316 billion.
Net income of $920 million, at a margin 2 of 18.8%.
GAAP diluted earnings per share (“EPS”) of $14.77, and adjusted EPS 3 of $15.55.
Total revenue $18.0 billion to $18.2 billion $17.5 billion to $17.8 billion
Year-to-date net cash provided by operating activities of $4.934 billion; free cash flow 3 of $1.421 billion, including gross payments for purchases of rental equipment of $4.339 billion.

quotes.text: I’m very pleased with our third-quarter results, which are a testament to our strategy, our team’s dedication to our customers, and the unmatched breadth and scale of our premier offering.

outlook: The company expects to complete $1.5 billion of share repurchases in 2026.

items.heading: Challenging economic conditions and the occurrence of unforeseen or catastrophic events, including public health crises and epidemics, have in the past adversely impacted, and may in the future adversely impact, us, our customers or our suppliers and in turn adversely affect our business, revenues and operating results.
Our industry is highly competitive, and competitive pressures have in the past led, and could lead again in the future, to a decrease in our market share or in the prices that we can charge.

Trends in oil and natural gas prices have in the past adversely affected, and could again in the future adversely affect, the level of exploration, development and production activity of certain of our customers and the demand for our services and products.
Increases in fuel costs or reduced supplies of fuel have in the past harmed, and could in the future again harm, our business.
Our significant indebtedness exposes us to various risks.
items.group: Risks Related to our Indebtedness and Liquidity

items.heading: We may not be able to refinance our indebtedness on favorable terms, or at all. Our inability to refinance our indebtedness could materially and adversely affect our liquidity and our ongoing results of operations.
